import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile

REPOSITORY = 'holdmyspot-com/codex-unleashed'
RUNS = 'repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/actions/workflows/runner-debug-smoke.yml/runs?branch=main.new&event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=20'


def api(path):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', path], text=True))


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    phase = sys.argv[2]
    if phase == 'run':
        before = set(json.loads((work / 'runs-before.json').read_text()))
        candidates = [r for r in api(RUNS)['workflow_runs'] if r['id'] not in before]
        target = json.loads((work / 'dispatch.json').read_text())['inputs']['target']
        candidates = [run for run in candidates if any(job['name'] == 'Debug - ' + target
            for job in api('repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/actions/runs/' + str(run['id']) + '/jobs?per_page=20')['jobs'])]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            print('awaiting dispatched workflow identity')
            return 75
        if len(candidates) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError('Dispatched run identity is ambiguous')
        run = candidates[0]
        assert run['head_sha'] == json.loads((work / 'settings.json').read_text())['workflow_head']
        (work / 'live-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(run, indent=2) + '\n')
        print('dispatched run', run['id'], run['status'])
        return 0
    if phase == 'artifact':
        run = json.loads((work / 'live-run.json').read_text())
        artifacts = api('repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/actions/runs/' + str(run['id']) + '/artifacts')['artifacts']
        candidates = [a for a in artifacts if a['name'].startswith(json.loads((work / 'settings.json').read_text())['artifact_prefix'])]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            print('awaiting live connection artifact for', run['id'])
            return 75
        assert len(candidates) == 1
        artifact = candidates[0]
        packed = subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', 'repos/' + REPOSITORY + '/actions/artifacts/' + str(artifact['id']) + '/zip'])
        (work / 'connection.zip').write_bytes(packed)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(packed)) as archive:
            assert archive.namelist() == ['connection.json']
            (work / 'connection.json').write_bytes(archive.read('connection.json'))
        (work / 'live-artifact.json').write_text(json.dumps(artifact, indent=2) + '\n')
        print('retrieved live connection artifact', artifact['id'])
        return 0
    if phase == 'start':
        (work / 'runs-before.json').write_text(json.dumps([r['id'] for r in api(RUNS)['workflow_runs']]))
        inputs = {'target': json.loads((work / 'settings.json').read_text())['target'], 'public_key': (work / 'client-key.pub').read_text().strip()}
        dispatched = subprocess.run(['gh', 'workflow', 'run', 'runner-debug-smoke.yml', '--repo', REPOSITORY,
            '--ref', 'main.new', '--json'], input=json.dumps(inputs), text=True, capture_output=True)
        (work / 'dispatch.json').write_text(json.dumps({'inputs': inputs, 'exit': dispatched.returncode,
            'stdout': dispatched.stdout, 'stderr': dispatched.stderr}, indent=2) + '\n')
        assert dispatched.returncode == 0, dispatched.stderr
    else:
        assert phase == 'resume'
        assert json.loads((work / 'dispatch.json').read_text())['exit'] == 0
    waiter = '/home/gili/codex-unleashed/home/.codex/plugins/cache/cat/cat/1.0/bin/wait-until'
    for check_phase in ['run', 'artifact']:
        command = shlex.join([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(work), check_phase])
        result = subprocess.run([waiter, '--check', command, '--deadline', '10m', '--interval', '2s'])
        assert result.returncode == 0, check_phase
    print('Starting SSH immediately for run', json.loads((work / 'live-run.json').read_text())['id'], flush=True)
    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name('client.py')), str(work)])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pty
import re
import select
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    details = json.loads((work / 'connection.json').read_text())
    arguments = shlex.split(details['sshCommand'])
    arguments[1:1] = ['-tt', '-i', str(work / 'client-key'),
        '-o', 'IdentitiesOnly=yes', '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes',
        '-o', 'UserKnownHostsFile=' + str(Path('.github/actions/debug-failed-runner/known_hosts').resolve())]
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    child = subprocess.Popen(arguments, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave)
    transcript = open(work / 'ssh-transcript', 'ab', buffering=0)
    buffer = b''
    connected = False
    active = None
    completed = 0
    while (work / f'result-{completed}.json').exists():
        completed += 1
    keepalive = time.monotonic()
    try:
        while child.poll() is None:
            readable, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)
            if readable:
                try:
                    data = os.read(master, 65536)
                except OSError:
                    break
                if data == b'':
                    break
                transcript.write(data)
                buffer += data
            plain = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[(?:\d+;)?1[Hf]', b'\n', buffer)
            plain = re.sub(rb'\x1b\][^\x07]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\)', b'', plain)
            plain = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', plain)
            if connected is False and re.search(rb'[$#] ?$', plain):
                connected = True
                (work / 'connected').write_text(str(child.pid))
                print('authenticated shell ready', flush=True)
                buffer = b''
            if active is not None and re.search(rb'\r?\n' + re.escape(active['marker'].encode()) + rb'\r?\n', plain):
                (work / f'result-{completed}.json').write_text(json.dumps(active))
                exit_match = re.search(rb'(?:^|[\r\n])REMOTE-COMMAND-EXIT-' + str(completed).encode() + rb'=(\d+)\r?\n', plain)
                if exit_match is None or exit_match.group(1) != b'0':
                    (work / 'halted.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command': completed, 'reason': 'Remote command failed; retain worker for diagnosis'}))
                print('command completed', completed, flush=True)
                completed += 1
                active = None
                buffer = b''
            if connected and active is None and (work / 'halted.json').exists() and time.monotonic() - keepalive >= 20:
                os.write(master, b"printf 'RETAINED-FOR-DIAGNOSIS\\n'\n")
                keepalive = time.monotonic()
            queue = work / 'commands.json'
            if connected and active is None and queue.exists() and not (work / 'halted.json').exists():
                commands = json.loads(queue.read_text())
                if len(commands) > completed:
                    active = commands[completed]
                    payload = (active['command'] + '\n').encode()
                    while payload:
                        count = os.write(master, payload)
                        payload = payload[count:]
        status = child.wait()
        (work / 'ssh-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit': status, 'completed': completed, 'ended_epoch': time.time()}))
        print('ssh exited', status, flush=True)
        return status
    finally:
        transcript.close()
        os.close(master)
        if child.poll() is None:
            child.terminate()
            child.wait()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

import base64
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(sys.argv.pop(1)).resolve()
queue = root / 'commands.json'
commands = json.loads(queue.read_text())

def add(command):
    number = len(commands)
    marker = 'SUPERVISOR-COMMAND-' + str(number)
    wrapped = ('bash -c ' + shlex.quote('set -e; ' + command) + '; TASK_COMMAND_EXIT=$?; '
               'printf "\\nREMOTE-COMMAND-EXIT-' + str(number) + '=%s\\n" "$TASK_COMMAND_EXIT"; '
               'printf "' + marker + '\\n"')
    subprocess.run(['bash', '-n'], input=wrapped, text=True, check=True)
    commands.append({'command': wrapped, 'marker': marker})

if sys.argv[1] == 'upload':
    payload = root / (sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'payload.tar.gz')
    data = payload.read_bytes()
    encoded = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
    add(': > "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/payload.base64"')
    for offset in range(0, len(encoded), 512):
        add("printf '%s' " + shlex.quote(encoded[offset:offset + 512]) + ' >> "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/payload.base64"')
    expected = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    add('base64 -d "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/payload.base64" > "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/payload.tar.gz"; '
        'test "$(sha256sum "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/payload.tar.gz" | cut -d " " -f 1)" = ' + shlex.quote(expected) + '; '
        'tar -xzf "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/payload.tar.gz" -C "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK"' +
        ('; python3 "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/setup.py" "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK" > "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/setup.log" 2>&1; '
         'cat "$SUPERVISOR_PROOF_WORK/setup.log"' if len(sys.argv) == 2 else ''))
else:
    add(sys.argv[1])
temporary = queue.with_suffix('.new')
temporary.write_text(json.dumps(commands, indent=2) + '\n')
temporary.replace(queue)
print('queued_through=' + str(len(commands) - 1))

from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
number = int(sys.argv[2])
if (root / 'halted.json').exists():
    print((root / 'halted.json').read_text())
    sys.exit(1)
if not (root / ('result-' + str(number) + '.json')).exists():
    if (root / 'ssh-exit.json').exists():
        print('SSH ended before command completion: ' + (root / 'ssh-exit.json').read_text())
        sys.exit(1)
    sys.exit(75)
text = (root / 'ssh-transcript').read_text(errors='replace')
text = re.sub(r'\x1b\[(?:\d+;)?1[Hf]', '\n', text)
text = re.sub(r'\x1b\][^\x07]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\)', '', text)
text = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', '', text)
rows = re.findall(r'\r?\nREMOTE-COMMAND-EXIT-' + str(number) + r'=(\d+)\r?\n', text)
assert len(rows) == 1, 'Missing or ambiguous actual command exit'
print('remote_command=' + str(number) + '; actual_exit=' + rows[0])
print('\n'.join(line[:500] for line in text.splitlines()[-28:] if len(line) <= 2000))
sys.exit(0 if rows[0] == '0' else 1)
